summary: Tested 6 bug fixes for MoneySutra app - All major bugs verified as FIXED

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 bugs verified fixed via UI testing)

bug_1_mobile_layout.description: Financial Health 'Expand' button overflow on mobile
bug_1_mobile_layout.verification: Buttons (Best First, Expand) fit within 390px viewport (right edges at 136px, 204px), displayed on separate row below title

bug_2_double_word.description: Bank Account Detail page showing 'BANK ACCOUNT ACCOUNT' double word
bug_2_double_word.verification: Header shows 'BANK ACCOUNT' (single) with proper account name below

bug_3_investment_allocation.description: Investment Allocation showing 100% overexposed when user has bond/gold funds

bug_4_life_insurance_score.description: Life Insurance score showing 1.9/7.5 when current coverage is 0
bug_4_life_insurance_score.verification: API returns rawScore: 0, contribution: 0.0, status: 'Not Covered' when coverage is 0

bug_5_income_start_date.description: Add Start Date field to income forms
bug_5_income_start_date.verification: All 5 income forms have data-testid='start-date-input' field - JobIncome, SelfEmployedIncome, BusinessIncome, CommissionIncome, OtherIncomeForm

bug_6_start_date_api.description: Start Date should be included in save payload
bug_6_start_date_api.verification: Income API model includes startDate field, tested via GET /api/income and PUT /api/income/{id}

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 bugs tested and verified as fixed. Income form routes: /job-income, /self-employed-income, /business-income, /commission-income, /other-income. Account detail route: /wealth/accounts/{id}. Use session_token cookie for auth.
